verdict.rationale: No downloadable OpenAPI or Swagger spec was found: every probed path (openapi.json, swagger.json, /api/openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json) returned 404. Kit does offer agent-consumable substitutes: an llms.txt index, per-page markdown versions of the API reference, and a Docs MCP server that lets agents query the full API reference live. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/Swagger (or equivalent formal schema) file, documentation of where such a spec could be downloaded, and independent confirmation that the markdown/MCP surface is complete enough to generate clients.
